sentences.en: No matter how thin you slice it, it's still baloney.
sentences.zh: 无论你怎么切，这都还是胡说八道。

sentences.en: I've put a slice of cake on the table. Enjoy!
sentences.zh: 我把一块蛋糕放在桌子上。享受吧！

sentences.en: Give me the knife and let me slice the bread.
sentences.zh: 把刀递给我，让我来切面包。
